methodology.purpose: Compare MCP security scanners without treating vendor claims as measured benchmark results.
rules: Run each scanner against the same benchmark corpus.
Record stdout, stderr, exit code, version, and runtime.
Map native findings to benchmark categories using explicit adapters.
Do not infer a detection from documentation alone.
Unavailable tools are recorded as unavailable, never as zero detections.

scanners.notes: Broad runtime, SAST, configuration and supply-chain scanner.
Static/dynamic scanning plus proxy and client configuration discovery.
Checks tool poisoning, SSRF, credential leaks, input validation and related classes.
